summary.one_liner: Official repository for Qwen3, Alibaba's family of open-weight dense and Mixture-of-Experts large language models, with usage guides for running, deploying, and fine-tuning them.
summary.what_it_does: The README introduces the Qwen3 model family (dense and MoE models from 0.6B up to 235B-A22B) and the Qwen3-2507 updates, which include separate Instruct and Thinking variants and support for 256K-token context extendable to 1 million tokens. It gives Transformers code snippets for chat generation and shows how to switch thinking mode on or off for earlier Qwen3 models. It documents local inference with llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, MLX LM, ExecuTorch, MNN, and OpenVINO, and server deployment with SGLang, vLLM, and TensorRT-LLM. It also points to Qwen-Agent for tool use and lists training frameworks such as Axolotl, LLaMA-Factory, and Swift for fine-tuning. Model weights are distributed through Hugging Face and ModelScope.
use_cases: run a local chat LLM on a laptop or GPU
serve an OpenAI-compatible API for a language model
fine-tune an open LLM with SFT or GRPO
run long-context document processing with up to 1M tokens
deploy a model on mobile or Apple Silicon
notable: Dense and MoE models from 0.6B to 235B-A22B, with separate Instruct and Thinking variants in the 2507 release
Switchable thinking and non-thinking modes for earlier Qwen3 models via enable_thinking or /think and /no_think
Context support of 256K tokens, extendable to 1 million tokens
Wide local and server runtime coverage, from llama.cpp and Ollama to vLLM, SGLang, and TensorRT-LLM
caveats: Ollama default context settings (num_ctx 2048) can cause problems, so users must set num_ctx and num_predict manually
Multi-step tool use with Qwen3 thinking models may be degraded in SGLang and vLLM because reasoning_content is dropped during request preprocessing
The README is a model-release hub, so the actual model weights and detailed guides live in linked Hugging Face, ModelScope, and documentation pages; the repository itself contains no model code
